page.layout: One block of text at full width at the top, with a woodcut ornament in the middle of the page, and a catchword at the lower right margin.

main_text.p: restitutus & voce & scripto errorem novitium superstitionémque Papæ damnavit, discipulos, quos in Gallia & Germania habuit permultos, in veritate confirmavit, & in eadem, uti etiam Baronius conjicit, ad finem usque vitæ perseveravit.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament between the text and the catchword is not transcribed. The catchword "Ec-" stands at the lower right, outside the text block. The first line of the text has a fragment at its start ("restitutus") and the printed text reads "superstitionémque" with the hyphen at the line end. Long s is rendered as s throughout.
